status: ACTIVE: read by stages/lib/blank_junk/method.py. Logic: docs/BLANK_JUNK_LOGIC.md.
notes: Matching: case-insensitive, on word boundaries, after whitespace is collapsed. 'terms' are literal phrases; 'patterns' are regexes (Python syntax).

Score: UNIQUE hits. Each distinct term or pattern of a group counts once, however often it appears. group score = weight x (number of distinct terms/patterns that hit), then capped at the group's 'cap'. Overlapping phrases: the longest wins. context score = sum of its group scores. See docs/BLANK_JUNK_LOGIC.md
weight = how much one hit is worth (1 = common, ambiguous; 2 = typical; 3-4 = nearly decisive). cap = the most one group can add, so one repeated word cannot reach a threshold alone.
line_start: true means the term counts only at the start of a line (alone, or followed by ':' or '-'). Used for section headings, so 'plan' inside a sentence does not count.

zone: 'any' | 'header' | 'body' | 'footer'. Header is the top 'header_band' of the page height, footer the bottom 'footer_band'. Pass 1 has no coordinates, so every zone is read as 'any' there. A junk term in the header or footer only counts when the body has at least one junk hit too.

Physician names do not go here. A signed note (R4) is detected only from kv_extract's Electronic Signature (provider_signature.csv signature_present = Y), which runs before pass 2. The signature phrase group was removed 2026-10-21.

No 'instructions' junk group (patient instructions are clinical) and no 'insurance' demographic group (insurance wording sits on clinical, demographic and junk pages alike; it is neutral). The Instructions subtype can still come from DistilBERT.

duplicates.note: 2026-10-22 (user): pages are compared on their distinct words as read (nothing stripped). overlap = shared distinct words / all distinct words of the two pages; contained = share of the smaller page's distinct words found on the other. Overlap >= 98%, or contained >= contained_at, is a duplicate; overlap 95-98% a partial. (Page-number and changed-word rules were removed the same day.)
duplicates.length_note: A duplicate's shorter page is at least duplicate_min_length_ratio of the longer one's length (whitespace-stripped characters); otherwise the pair is a partial at most (2026-10-22, user: duplicates are about the same length).
duplicates.bands_note: Distinct words different = distinct words on only one of the two pages, both sides added. Duplicate: contained, or overlap >= 98%, or fewer than duplicate_below_words different. Partial: overlap 95-98%, or fewer than partial_below_words different. Else neither (2026-10-22, user). The word counts apply only at overlap >= count_rule_min_overlap: two short unrelated pages also differ in few words.
duplicates.which_page_note: Which page is the duplicate (2026-10-22, user): the later page (order of appearance) -- unless one page is contained in the other and the larger has more than larger_kept_above_words distinct words the smaller lacks: then the larger page stays and the smaller is the duplicate.
duplicates.signature_note: 2026-10-26 (user): a signature or ending page standing apart is not a duplicate: a pair with one (kv_extract's Electronic Signature in pass 2, or any signature_terms on the page) is skipped when a Main page lies between them (other notes, other DOSs). Side by side they still compare.

short_page.note: Short page rule R6, pass 2, after R4 (signature) and before R5 (DistilBERT); restored 2026-10-21. Content that ends within the top 'top_fraction' (15%) of the page height, footer band and running stamps left out, with less than body_ink_max_fraction ink below -> JUNK / Others (confidence 0.95). Not when DistilBERT p(keep) > skip_keep_above (0.90), when the word boxes or the image cannot be read, or when R4 kept the page (docs/BLANK_JUNK_LOGIC.md).
short_page.note_body_ink: Ink below the short band = the share of the 17%-94% band (body_ink_band; it starts 2% below top_fraction) that is dark ink strokes (hw_printed.page_marks strong_fraction). At or above body_ink_max_fraction (0.5%, 2026-10-18; was 0.01%) the page has content below and R6 does not junk it; a stamp, logo or fax line (~0.2%) no longer blocks it. votes.short_page records ink, ink_fraction and ink_limit.
short_page.note_patterns: A line matching any of these (anywhere in the line) is a running header / footer stamp, not content: 'Page 3 of 7', 'MRN: 023466 Printed: 10/30/2025 8:10 AM Pg 14 of 17', a bare page number, a fax transmission line.

visual.note: Visual = ocr_quality_results.document_type == 'visual' (CSV column document_type). Rule R3, before signature, DistilBERT, short page, retrieval and clinical: on every visual page, card evidence (card_group, id_card: a card term or card-number pattern) is required; with it, card + vendor + insurer + retrieval + invoice wording (veto_junk_groups) >= veto_min_score -> Junk / Others, whatever the word count. Vendors and insurers only add weight: without a card term they never fire R3. Else fewer than max_words words -> Main. Else (a visual page with more text) the rest of the ladder and the vote decide. Pass 2 skips visual pages under max_words (decided in pass 1). Changed 2026-10-19: was R8, after R7, veto at 7.

section_headings.note_heading_line: A heading term counts when it starts a line followed by ':' / '-' / the line end, or anywhere in a short line (<= heading_line_max_words words, a heading): 'Allergies and Adverse Reactions', 'Medications Reconciled', 'Assessment & Plan Summary'. Added 2026-10-19.

patient_education.note: Patient education and instruction handouts are part of the record (Non-Codable page type 'Patient Education' / 'Discharge Instructions' in page classification, which runs after blank/junk). Two hits make the page clinical (C), so DistilBERT cannot force it to junk (R5.1) and the vote keeps it.
terms: is not meant to be comprehensive
if you received this fax in error

cover_stamps.note: Accept / Unaccept stamps and check boxes on retrieval cover pages. line_start so 'patient accepted the referral' in a note does not count.

id_card.note: Insurance / ID cards and driver's licences (scanned card images). Counted only on pages the page-tag model calls visual (document_type), with or without the Visual word limit; on other pages it adds nothing. A junk indicator, not demographic: demographic terms keep a page, and a card's name / DOB would otherwise rescue it. Hard junk (method HARD_JUNK_GROUPS): it beats the demographic KEEP and counts toward the Visual card check (R3). Two terms (8) = a strong JUNK ballot. Added 2026-10-19. 2026-10-19: insurance-card wording and card-number patterns (Member ID / BIN / PCN / Group / copay) added; insurance words stay neutral on non-visual pages. Its hits are the card evidence R3 requires. 2026-10-19: pharmacy wording (RxBIN / PCN / RxGRP, for pharmacist, rx claims) is not card evidence and was removed.

insurers.note: Health-plan names on a visual page (an insurance card's logo). Counted only on visual pages. Not card evidence: they add weight to the R3 card check and to the keyword ballot, but never fire R3 alone. Weight 2: one insurer is not a JUNK ballot. Added 2026-10-19.

neutral.note: Never counted for any context: letterhead, transmission stamps, boilerplate and insurance wording that appear on clinical, demographic and junk pages alike.

distilbert.note: 2026-10-20: DistilBERT alone decides after R1-R4 (method.py). Pass 1: p(keep) above pass1_final_keep_above -> Main, final, pass 2 skipped; p(junk) above pass1_final_junk_above -> Junk, final, pass 2 and Final OCR 2 skipped (2026-10-22; not on a page more than handwritten_veto % handwritten; like every page pass 1 settles it gets Final OCR 1, stored only); every other page waits for pass 2. Pass 2: R4 (signature) is overruled when p(junk) is above signature_overruled_above; then R6 (short_page, restored 2026-10-21); R5: p(junk) >= junk_at -> Junk, review_junk_at..junk_at -> Junk for review, below review_junk_at -> Main. p(junk) = every JUNK_* label plus BLANK.

voters.retired: 2026-10-20: the keyword / DistilBERT vote is gone; see distilbert. Kept for reference only.

bert.note_force_keep: Both passes: p(junk) below force_keep_below -> Main (method R5.2), after R1-R4 and R5.1, so no later rule (short page, retrieval, the vote) can reverse it.
bert.note: Pass 2: p(junk) = sum of JUNK_* + BLANK above force_junk_above -> JUNK forced (method R5.1), overruled only by blank, placeholder and Provider Signature = Yes, and not applied when the canon finds clinical (>= thresholds.clinical) or demographic (>= thresholds.demographic) evidence: then the vote decides. Pass 1: not forced, counts as a strong JUNK ballot.

keyword.note: Votes from the J/C/D table docs/BLANK_JUNK_LOGIC.md Strength: JUNK is strong at junk >= junk_strong, KEEP is strong at clinical >= clinical_strong.
keyword.note_junk_alone: Vote row 3 (DistilBERT abstains, keywords vote JUNK): Junk only when the keyword junk score is at least this; below it the page stays Main.

handwritten_veto.note: Section 8.3: a JUNK vote is turned into KEEP + review only when the handwritten share of the page is above this. Needs the page-tag model (handwritten_area_pct); without it the veto does not apply and votes.hw_area = 'none'.

note_confidence: Confidence is the evidence for the verdict (docs/BLANK_JUNK_LOGIC.md), not a fixed number: DistilBERT's probability (when it scored the page), the keyword score (junk / 10, or clinical-or-demographic / 10) and, for R3 and R6-R8, the rule's own value. Signals that agree combine as 1 - product(1 - p); a disagreement is averaged. R1, R2 and R4 (signature) keep fixed values. There is no cap: a contested call comes out low by itself, so filter on low confidence to review.
dos_keep_note: 2026-10-26 (user), post-processing after the ladder in pass 2: a page with a DOS, an Electronic Signature or provider details (name / credentials) extracted by kv_extract is never junk -> Main. Duplicates and Blank are not changed.
